caption: The drawing depicts a metal pitcher or coffee pot with a long, narrow spout and a curved handle. The body of the pot is mostly a deep reddish-brown color with painted decorative motifs. The decoration features yellow and green leaves, a prominent yellow flower, and what appears to be a red fruit or apple. The lid has a circular, concentric pattern in shades of brown and red with a small knob on top. The handle and spout show areas of wear with some faded or chipped paint, and the spout has additional yellow floral decoration near its base. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast with the detailed and colorful object. The artist’s signature, "Oscar Bluemner," is visible in small letters at the lower right area near the bottom of the page.
title: Toleware Teapot
